The Club

More Than a Club.
A Way of Life.

Nestled in Vero Beach on Florida’s Treasure Coast, The Boulevard Tennis and Padel Club blends world-class racquet sports with vibrant social energy. Where competitive play meets community — members come for a match and stay for the lifestyle.

Programming supports players at every stage through clinics, lessons, leagues, events, and organized match play — thoughtfully structured to balance competitive opportunities with social play.

Tennis & Pádel at The BLVD

Whether you’re looking for social play, competitive leagues, or family programming, The Boulevard has a place for you on court.

Tennis

  • 12 Har-Tru clay courts, fully lit

🏓

Pádel

  • 3 championship courts

Competitive Play

IRCTA intra-club leagues, USTA teams, and advanced nights for members seeking consistent, high-level match play in tennis and pádel.

🎈

Events & Socials

Holiday mixers, member-guest tournaments, club championships, golf & tennis challenges, pádel invitationals, and community events year-round.

⭐

Junior Development

Red, orange, and green ball through advanced and high-performance programs. Summer camps and homeschool clinics for every age.

🍴

Dining & Social

The Padel Grille: farm-to-table with organic & vegan options, full bar, happy hour Mon–Thu, fire pit lounge, and private event hosting.
